description: SALOME is an open-source platform for numerical simulation developed by CEA, EDF and OPEN CASCADE. The site read on 2026-09-26 lists parametric CAD with SHAPER, meshing with SMESH, scientific visualisation, supervision, data assimilation, uncertainty treatment, field manipulation and interpolation between meshes, and solving PDEs with SolverLab, with domain applications salome_meca, salome_cfd, salome hydro and TRUST. SALOME 9.16.0 was announced on 27 July 2026, after 9.15.0 in September 2025. Coverage is general engineering physics, and the project is distributed under the open source LGPL licence at no cost. Access is through a download form offering Windows installers and archives, builds for several CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora releases, a universal Linux build and source, together with the MED file format library, documentation, a forum and git repositories. Caveats: SALOME is a pre and post processing and coupling environment, so physics solvers such as code_aster or TRUST are needed for the analysis itself. Simulation uses are building geometry and meshes for nuclear plant components, coupling solvers and handling uncertainty, and the modelling front end of digital twin workflows. Related records: platform-code-aster-structural-mechanics and platform-trust-triocfd-thermohydraulics are solvers used with SALOME, and platform-code-saturne-cfd is EDF's CFD solver.
